$comment: Copy to ~/.nitro-ui/devices.json on each machine and edit. One file per machine: UDIDs, AVD names and ports do not travel between machines, which is why briefs must stop naming them (docs/tasks/PROCESS-review-2026-10-26.md section 4, rank 7). Override the path with NITRO_UI_DEVICES, the directory with NITRO_UI_HOME. Lease them with: node scripts/lease.mjs acquire --task <id>. Placeholder identifiers below - create the real devices first (xcrun simctl create, avdmanager create avd) and paste their UDID/AVD names here.
